qe: Which Article is known as the 'Soul and Heart' of the Constitution?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar ne Article 32 (Right to Constitutional Remedies) ko 'Soul' kaha tha. \n2. Reason: Iske bina baaki saare rights sirf kagaz par reh jayenge. \n3. Power: Iske tehat aap seedha Supreme Court ja sakte hain.

qe: The 'Right to Property' was removed from Fundamental Rights by which amendment?
e: 1. History: 1978 mein Morarji Desai sarkar ne ise hataya tha. \n2. Status: Ab ye Article 300A ke tehat sirf ek 'Legal Right' (कानूनी अधिकार) hai. \n3. Logic: Taaki sarkar vikas ke liye zameen le sake.

qe: Which Fundamental Right cannot be suspended even during Emergency?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Article 20 (Protection in conviction) aur Article 21 (Life and Liberty) kabhi khatam nahi hote. \n2. Rule: Ye 44th Amendment ne pakka kiya tha taaki Emergency mein sarkar manmani na kare.

qe: Under Article 21A, the State shall provide free and compulsory education to children of age?
e: 1. Logic: 86th Amendment (2002) se ise joda gaya. \n2. Duty: Ye Parents ki Fundamental Duty bhi hai (Article 51A).

qe: Which 'Writ' is issued by the court to release a person who has been illegally detained?
e: 1. Meaning: Habeas Corpus ka matlab hai 'To have the body'. \n2. Power: Court police ko order deta hai ki pakde gaye bande ko 24 ghante mein samne pesh karo.

qe: Article 17 of the Constitution deals with the abolition of?
e: 1. Logic: Ye 'Right to Equality' ka part hai. \n2. Penalty: Untouchability practice karna ek kanooni jurm hai.

qe: The 'Directive Principles of State Policy' (DPSP) are borrowed from which Constitution?
e: 1. Source: Ireland ne ise Spain se liya tha, aur humne Ireland se. \n2. Nature: Ye 'Non-Justiciable' hain (yani inke liye aap court nahi ja sakte).

qe: Which Article provides for a 'Uniform Civil Code' (UCC) for the citizens?
e: 1. Logic: 44 (Four-Four) dono digital barabar hain, matlab sabke liye 'Equal Law'. \n2. State: Goa Bharat ka akela state hai jahan UCC lagu hai.

qe: Protection against 'Double Jeopardy' is mentioned in which Article?
e: 1. Rule: Article 20(2) kehta hai ki kisi ko ek hi jurm ke liye do baar saza nahi di ja sakti.

qe: Which Article separates the 'Judiciary' from the 'Executive' in DPSP?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: DM (Executive) aur Judge (Judiciary) ki powers alag honi chahiye, ye Article 50 kehta hai.

qe: Under Article 19, how many types of 'Freedoms' are guaranteed?
e: 1. Logic: Pehle 7 thin, par Right to Property hatne ke baad ab 6 bachi hain (Speech, Assembly, Association, Movement, Residence, Profession).

qe: Article 25 to 28 deal with which Fundamental Right?
e: 1. Logic: Ye har nagrik ko apne dharam ko manne aur prachar karne ka haq dete hain.

qe: Who is the 'Guardian' of Fundamental Rights in India?
e: 1. Power: Agar aapke rights chine jayein, toh Supreme Court (Art 32) aur High Court (Art 226) unhe wapas dilwate hain.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Equal justice and free legal aid'?
e: 1. Logic: Ise 42nd Amendment se add kiya gaya taaki garibo ko sasta nyay mile.

qe: The concept of 'Rule of Law' (Article 14) is taken from?
e: 1. Fact: A.V. Dicey ne Rule of Law ka principle diya tha.

qe: Article 23 prohibits which of the following?
o: Human Trafficking and Begar (मानव तस्करी और बेगार)
e: 1. Right: Right against Exploitation. \n2.Begar: Bina paise diye kaam karwana.

qe: Which Article directs the state to promote 'International Peace and Security'?
e: 1. Fact: Ye DPSP ka aakhri article hai aur India ki foreign policy ka base hai.

qe: Fundamental Duties were added to the Constitution on the recommendation of?
e: 1. Logic: 42nd Amendment (1976) se Part IV-A aur Art 51A joda gaya.

qe: Under Article 24, children below what age are prohibited from working in hazardous industries?
e: 1. Right: Prohibition of Child Labour.

qe: Which Article describes DPSP as 'Fundamental in the governance of the country'?
e: 1. Logic: Art 37 kehta hai ki bhale hi ye court mein enforce nahi ho sakte, par sarkar ko kanoon banate waqt inka dhyan rakhna chahiye.

qe: Which Landmark Case established the 'Basic Structure Doctrine' (बुनियादी ढांचा सिद्धांत)?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: 1973 mein 13 जजों की सबसे बड़ी बेंच ने ये फैसला दिया. \n2. Rule: Parliament Samvidhan badal sakti hai, par uske 'Basic Structure' (jaise Democracy, Secularism) ko nahi chhu sakti.

qe: Article 15 prohibits discrimination on how many grounds?
o: 5 (पाँच - धर्म, मूलवंश, जाति, लिंग, जन्म स्थान)
e: 1. Logic: Religion, Race, Caste, Sex aur Place of birth. \n2. Note: 'Residence' (निवास) isme shamil nahi hai, isliye states apne logo ko naukri mein preference de sakte hain.

qe: Under Article 22, a person arrested must be produced before a Magistrate within?
o: 24 hours (24 घंटे - यात्रा के समय को छोड़कर)
e: 1. Right: Protection against Arrest. \n2. Logic: Bina Magistrate ki ijazat ke police kisi ko 24 ghante se zyada lockup mein nahi rakh sakti.

qe: Which Article protects the interests of 'Minorities' to establish educational institutions?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: 29 unke culture ki raksha karta hai, aur 30 unhe school//college chalane ka haq deta hai.

qe: The 'Gram Panchayat' (Article 40) is based on whose philosophy?
e: 1. Logic: Gandhi ji chahte the ki 'Swaraj' gaon se shuru ho. \n2. Conflict: Dr. Ambedkar iske khilaaf the kyunki wo gaon mein caste system se darte the.

qe: Article 44 (Uniform Civil Code) is a part of?
e: 1. Status: Ye sarkar ke liye ek nirdesh hai, par mandatory nahi hai. \n2. Current: Bihar aur desh bhar mein ispar behes chalti rehti hai.

qe: Which Writ literally means 'We Command' (हम आदेश देते हैं)?
e: 1. Logic: Mandamus tab jari hoti hai jab koi sarkari adhikari apna farz pura nahi karta. \n2. Limit: Ye President ya Governor ke khilaaf jari nahi ho sakti.

qe: Under Article 51A, how many Fundamental Duties are there currently?
e: 1. History: 42nd Amendment se 10 duty aayi thin. \n2. Addition: 11th duty (Bachon ki shiksha) 86th Amendment (2002) se jodi gayi.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Separation of Judiciary from Executive'?
e: 1. Logic: Half-Half (50-50). Judiciary aur Executive ki powers mix nahi honi chahiye.

qe: Can DPSP override Fundamental Rights in any case?
e: 1. Smart Catch: Minerva Mills case mein kaha gaya ki 39b aur 39c (Resource distribution) ko lagu karne ke liye Art 14//19 ka ullanghan ho sakta hai. \n2. Logic: Samajik bhalayi personal rights se badi hai.

qe: Article 18 deals with the 'Abolition of Titles'. Which titles are allowed?
e: 1. Rule: Dr, Colonel, Brigadier jaise titles use kar sakte hain. \n2. Awards: Bharat Ratna ek samman hai, title nahi. Isliye ise naam ke aage nahi laga sakte.

qe: Protection of environment and wildlife is mentioned in which DPSP Article?
e: 1. Addition: Ise 42nd Amendment (1976) se joda gaya tha. \n2. Importance: Ye Bihar ke forest exams mein bahut pucha jata hai.

qe: Which Article provides 'Protection of Life and Personal Liberty'?
e: 1. Scope: Isme Right to Sleep, Right to Privacy, aur Right to Clean Air bhi shamil hain. \n2. Post-Mortem: Ye Samvidhan ka sabse bada Article mana jata hai interprets ke hisab se.

qe: The Writ 'Quo-Warranto' is issued to check?
o: Legality of a public office (सार्वजनिक पद की वैधानिकता)
e: 1. Meaning: 'By what authority?'. Agar koi bina eligibility ke kisi sarkari kursi par baith jaye toh court ye writ jari karta hai.

qe: Which DPSP Article promotes 'Village Industries' (Cottage industries)?
e: 1. Fact: Ye Gandhian Principle ka hissa hai taaki gaon ke logo ko rozgar mile.

qe: The 'Fundamental Rights' are justiciable. What does it mean?
o: They can be enforced by Courts (इन्हें अदालतों द्वारा लागू किया जा सकता है)
e: 1. Distinction: Rights ke liye aap seedha SC//HC ja sakte hain. DPSP ke liye nahi ja sakte (wo Non-justiciable hain).

qe: Article 39A (Free Legal Aid) was added by which amendment?
e: 1. Purpose: Garibo ko vakeel aur kanooni help dilwana.

qe: The 86th Amendment Act (2002) changed which DPSP Article?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Pehle Art 45 mein 6-14 saal ki education thi. \n2. Update: Jab education Fundamental Right (Art 21A) ban gayi, toh Art 45 mein ab 'Early childhood care' (0-6 saal) rakha gaya hai.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Promotion of Co-operative Societies'?
e: 1. Addition: Ise 97th Amendment (2011) se joda gaya tha. \n2. Fact: Bihar ke dairy aur farmers sectors ke liye ye important hai.

qe: Which Fundamental Right was called 'A check that can be cashed only when the bank has resources'?
e: 1. Logic: Professor K.T. Shah ne DPSP ke liye ye kaha tha kyunki ye sarkar ki marzi aur paise par depend karta hai.

qe: What is the 'Doctrine of Pith and Substance' used for in Constitutional cases?
qh: संवैधानिक मामलों में 'सार और तत्व का सिद्धांत' (Pith and Substance) का उपयोग क्यों किया जाता है?
o: To check if a law is within its legislative power (जाँचना कि कानून अपनी विधायी शक्ति के भीतर है)
To change the name of a law
e: 1. Core Concept: Jab Central ya State Govt koi kanoon banati hai, toh kabhi-kabhi wo galti se dusre ke subject mein ghus jati hai. \\n2. Logic: Court kanoon ki sirf upari (superficial) cheez nahi dekhta, balki uska asli 'Pith' (Maksad) aur 'Substance' (Saar) dekhta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Agar asli maksad sahi hai, toh kanoon valid mana jata hai, bhale hi wo thoda dusre area ko touch kare.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Constitutional Remedies' for the enforcement of Fundamental Rights in High Courts?
qh: हाई कोर्ट में मौलिक अधिकारों के प्रवर्तन के लिए 'संवैधानिक उपचार' का प्रावधान कौन सा अनुच्छेद करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Rights ki suraksha sirf Delhi (SC) mein nahi, states mein bhi hai. \\n2. Logic: Article 226 High Courts ko 'Writs' jari karne ki power deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: High Court ki writ power SC se wide hai, kyunki wo FR ke alawa 'Other Legal Rights' ke liye bhi writ nikal sakte hain.

qe: The 'Right to Education' (21A) was added following the judgment of which case?
qh: किस मामले के फैसले के बाद 'शिक्षा का अधिकार' (21A) जोड़ा गया था?
o: Mohini Jain vs State of Karnataka (मोहिनी जैन मामला)
Unni Krishnan vs State of AP
e: 1. Core Concept: Education ko 'Life' ka part mana gaya. \\n2. Logic: Mohini Jain case (1992) ne pehli baar kaha ki education bina dignified life namumkin hai. Unni Krishnan case ne ise 14 saal tak limit kiya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Inhi judgments ke baad Sansad ne 86th Amendment pass kiya.

qe: Under Article 19, 'Reasonable Restrictions' can be imposed on 'Freedom of Assembly' on which grounds?
qh: अनुच्छेद 19 के तहत, 'सभा करने की स्वतंत्रता' पर किन आधारों पर प्रतिबंध लगाया जा सकता है?
o: Both A and B (A और B दोनों)
e: 1. Core Concept: Azadi shanti banaye rakhne ke liye hai. \\n2. Logic: Agar aapki assembly (bheed) desh ki ekta ko tod rahi hai ya dange bhadka rahi hai, toh sarkar use ban kar sakti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Assembly hamesha 'Unarmed' (bina hathiyaro ke) honi chahiye.

qe: What is 'Double Jeopardy' under Article 20(2)?
qh: अनुच्छेद 20(2) के तहत 'दोहरा दंड' (Double Jeopardy) क्या है?
o: Punishing twice for the same offence (एक ही अपराध के लिए दो बार सजा देना)
Arresting two people for one crime
e: 1. Core Concept: Kanooni suraksha. \\n2. Logic: Kisi insaan ko ek hi jurm ke liye do baar court mein ghaseeta ya saza nahi di ja sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye protection sirf 'Judicial' (court) punishment par hai, 'Departmental' (office) punishment par nahi.

qe: Article 13(4) was added by the 24th Amendment to clarify that:
qh: 24वें संशोधन द्वारा अनुच्छेद 13(4) यह स्पष्ट करने के लिए जोड़ा गया था कि:
o: Constitutional Amendment is NOT a 'Law' under Article 13 (संविधान संशोधन अनुच्छेद 13 के तहत 'कानून' नहीं है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Parliament vs SC ki ladayi. \\n2. Logic: Iska matlab hai ki 'Constitutional Amendment' karke Rights ko badla ja sakta hai aur Article 13 use nahi rokega. \\n3. Extra Fact: Kesavananda Case ne ise valid mana, par 'Basic Structure' ki shart laga di.

qe: The writ of 'Certiorari' can be used to quash a decision of a:
qh: 'उत्प्रेषण' रिट का उपयोग किसके निर्णय को रद्द करने के लिए किया जा सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Legal error ko sudharna. \\n2. Logic: Agar kisi ne kanoon ki galti ki hai ya natural justice follow nahi kiya, toh Higher Court use 'Quash' (radd) kar sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: 1991 ke baad se ye sarkari officers ke faislo par bhi lagu hoti hai.

qe: Which Fundamental Right provides for 'Freedom from attending religious instruction' in certain institutions?
qh: कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार कुछ संस्थानों में 'धार्मिक शिक्षा में शामिल होने से स्वतंत्रता' प्रदान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Secular education policy. \\n2. Logic: Private schools jo sarkari madad lete hain, wo kisi bacche ko majboor nahi kar sakte ki wo unki prarthna ya dharmik class mein baithe. \\n3. Extra Fact: Parent ki consent (marzi) yahan zaroori hai.

qe: Article 35 empowers only the Parliament to make laws for FR. Why not State Legislatures?
qh: अनुच्छेद 35 केवल संसद को अधिकारों के लिए कानून बनाने की शक्ति देता है। राज्य विधानसभाओं को क्यों नहीं?
o: To maintain uniformity of FR across India (पूरे भारत में अधिकारों की एकरूपता बनाए रखने के लिए)
e: 1. Core Concept: Ek desh, ek adhikar. \\n2. Logic: Agar states kanoon banati toh Bihar mein 'Untouchability' ki saza alag hoti aur UP mein alag. Is disparity ko rokne ke liye power sirf Sansad ko di gayi. \\n3. Extra Fact: Jaise Armed Forces ke rights restrict karna (Art 33) sirf Sansad kar sakti hai.

qe: The 'Suspension of FR' during National Emergency (Art 359) does not apply to:
qh: राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान अधिकारों का निलंबन (अनुच्छेद 359) किस पर लागू नहीं होता?
e: 1. Core Concept: Life aur Personal Liberty ki supreme suraksha. \\n2. Logic: 44th Amendment (1978) ne ye rule banaya ki chahe kitni bhi badi emergency ho, Article 20 aur 21 hamesha zinda rahenge. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iska matlab hai ki police bina trial ke kisi ko maar nahi sakti.

qe: What is 'Colorable Legislation' in constitutional law?
qh: संवैधानिक कानून में 'छद्म विधान' (Colorable Legislation) क्या है?
o: Doing indirectly what cannot be done directly (जो प्रत्यक्ष रूप से नहीं किया जा सकता, उसे अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से करना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Fraud on Constitution. \\n2. Logic: Agar Parliament ke paas koi kanoon banane ki power nahi hai, toh wo use ghumakar (by dressing it up) nahi bana sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye check karne ke liye 'Pith and Substance' doctrine use hoti hai.

qe: Article 31A was primarily added to protect:
qh: अनुच्छेद 31A मुख्य रूप से किसकी रक्षा के लिए जोड़ा गया था?
e: 1. Core Concept: Social justice through land distribution. \\n2. Logic: Zamindaro ne property rights ka bahana lekar land reforms ko roka, isliye 1st Amendment se ise protection di gayi. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isne 5 categories ke laws ko Article 14 aur 19 ke violation se bachaya.

qe: Who can restrict the Fundamental Rights of employees in 'Intelligence Bureau'?
qh: 'इंटेलिजेंस ब्यूरो' (IB) के कर्मचारियों के मौलिक अधिकारों को कौन प्रतिबंधित कर सकता है?
o: The Parliament by law (संसद कानून द्वारा)
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 33 ki power. \\n2. Logic: Intelligence aur security forces ka 'Secrecy' aur 'Discipline' desh ke liye zaroori hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Is kanoon ko kisi court mein challenge nahi kiya ja sakta.

qe: The word 'Minority' in Article 30 refers to:
qh: अनुच्छेद 30 में 'अल्पसंख्यक' शब्द का तात्पर्य है:
e: 1. Core Concept: India mein minority do tarah ki hoti hain. \\n2. Logic: Samvidhan dharam aur bhasha dono ko minority ka base manta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Halanki 'Minority' shabd ko Samvidhan mein kahin bhi define nahi kiya gaya hai.

qe: Which Fundamental Right provides 'Right to get a speedy trial'?
qh: कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार 'त्वरित सुनवाई का अधिकार' प्रदान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Justice delayed is justice denied. \\n2. Logic: Hussainara Khatoon case mein SC ne kaha ki jail mein bina trial ke pade rehna Article 21 ka violation hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'Personal Liberty' ka ek advanced part hai.

qe: The writ of 'Mandamus' cannot be issued against a Governor of a State.
qh: 'परमादेश' रिट किसी राज्य के राज्यपाल के खिलाफ जारी नहीं की जा सकती।
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitutional Immunity. \\n2. Logic: Article 361 ke tehat President aur Governor ko unki official duties ke liye court ke prati jawabdeh nahi banaya gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Mandamus sirf un logo ke khilaaf nikalti hai jo 'Public Duty' nibhane ke liye kanooni taur par majboor hon.

qe: Article 16(4) allows reservation in public employment for 'Backward Classes'. Who decides who is backward?
qh: अनुच्छेद 16(4) पिछड़ी जातियों के लिए आरक्षण देता है। कौन तय करता है कि कौन पिछड़ा है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Executive power to identify. \\n2. Logic: Sarkar (State) commissions banakar (jaise Mandal Commission) pichde-pan ki report leti hai aur arakshan deti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Is decision ka 'Judicial Review' ho sakta hai taaki manmani na ho.

qe: Which Fundamental Right is also available to 'Legal Persons' like Corporations?
qh: कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार निगमों जैसे 'कानूनी व्यक्तियों' को भी उपलब्ध है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Person vs Citizen. \\n2. Logic: Article 14 sabhi 'Persons' (natural and legal) ke liye hai. Article 19 sirf 'Citizens' (insaan) ke liye hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isliye companies equality ki maang kar sakti hain par speech ki azadi (Art 19) unhe direct nahi milti.

qe: What was the 'Golaknath Case' (1967) judgment about?
qh: 'गोलकनाथ मामला' (1967) का फैसला किस बारे में था?
o: Fundamental Rights are 'Sacrosanct' and cannot be amended (अधिकार पवित्र हैं और संशोधित नहीं किए जा सकते)
e: 1. Core Concept: Rights ki supremacy. \\n2. Logic: 11 judges ki bench ne kaha ki Article 13 ke tehat Parliament Rights ko badal ya cheen nahi sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isi faisle ko badalne ke liye 24th Amendment laya gaya tha.

qe: Article 21A provides free education to children of age group:
qh: अनुच्छेद 21A किस आयु वर्ग के बच्चों को मुफ्त शिक्षा देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Compulsory elementary education. \\n2. Logic: 14 saal tak ki padhai basic requirement hai. Uske upar ki padhai (High school/College) 'Fundamental Right' nahi hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: 0-6 saal ke bacchon ki dekhbhal Article 45 (DPSP) mein aati hai.

qe: Which part of the Indian Constitution is known as the 'Magna Carta of India'?
qh: भारतीय संविधान के किस भाग को 'भारत का मैग्ना कार्टा' कहा जाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Magna Carta 1215 mein England mein laya gaya Rights ka pehla written document tha. \\n2. Logic: Part III mein 'Fundamental Rights' hain jo nagriko ko azadi aur suraksha dete hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme Article 12 se 35 tak shamil hain.

qe: Which Fundamental Right was deleted by the 44th Amendment Act, 1978?
qh: 44वें संशोधन अधिनियम, 1978 द्वारा किस मौलिक अधिकार को हटा दिया गया था?
e: 1. Core Concept: Pehle 7 Fundamental Rights the, ab sirf 6 hain. \\n2. Logic: Right to Property ko hata kar 'Legal Right' (Kanooni Adhikar) bana diya gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ab ye Article 300A ke andar Part XII mein hai.

qe: Article 17 of the Constitution deals with:
qh: संविधान का अनुच्छेद 17 किससे संबंधित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye 'Social Equality' (Samajik Barabari) lane ka ek kanoon hai. \\n2. Logic: Iska maksad chhua-chhoot ki pratha ko poori tarah khatam karna hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Is article ka koi 'Exception' nahi hai, ye absolute right hai.

qe: Under which Article can a person move the Supreme Court for violation of rights?
qh: अधिकारों के उल्लंघन के लिए किस अनुच्छेद के तहत सुप्रीम कोर्ट जाया जा सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Ise 'Right to Constitutional Remedies' kehte hain. \\n2. Logic: Agar aapke rights chhine jayein, toh Article 32 aapko direct Supreme Court jane ki power deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Dr. Ambedkar ne ise Samvidhan ki 'Heart and Soul' (Hriday aur Aatma) kaha tha.

qe: Which Article provides 'Protection of Life and Personal Liberty'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'जीवन और व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता का संरक्षण' प्रदान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye sabse bada aur important right hai. \\n2. Logic: Kisi bhi insaan ki azadi aur jaan bina kanooni process ke nahi li ja sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme 'Right to Privacy' aur 'Right to Clean Environment' bhi shamil hain.

qe: Article 24 prohibits the employment of children below what age in factories?
qh: अनुच्छेद 24 किस उम्र से कम के बच्चों के कारखानों में काम करने पर रोक लगाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye 'Right against Exploitation' (Shoshan ke khilaaf adhikar) hai. \\n2. Logic: 14 saal se kam umra ke bacchon ko khatarnak kamo (Hazardous jobs) mein lagana jurm hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Article baccho ke 'Health' aur 'Education' ko promote karta hai.

qe: The concept of 'Fundamental Rights' is borrowed from which country?
qh: 'मौलिक अधिकार' की अवधारणा किस देश से ली गई है?
e: 1. Core Concept: US Constitution mein ise 'Bill of Rights' kaha jata hai. \\n2. Logic: Humne wahan ki democratic values se prabhavit hokar ise apne Samvidhan mein dala. \\n3. Extra Fact: Lekin India ke rights US ke mukable zyada detail mein hain.

qe: Which Article deals with 'Equality before Law'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'कानून के समक्ष समानता' से संबंधित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Iska matlab hai 'Kanoon sabke liye barabar hai'. \\n2. Logic: Chahe koi amir ho ya garib, kanoon ki nazar mein sab ek hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'Rule of Law' (Kanoon ka shasan) ka mukhya hissa hai jo Britain se liya gaya hai.

qe: Article 19 provides how many types of 'Freedoms' to citizens?
qh: अनुच्छेद 19 नागरिकों को कितने प्रकार की 'स्वतंत्रता' प्रदान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye 'Right to Freedom' ka core hai. \\n2. Logic: Isme Speech, Assembly, Association, Movement, Residence, aur Profession ki azadi hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Pehle isme 7 freedoms thi, lekin 'Property' wali freedom ko hata diya gaya.

qe: Which Fundamental Rights are available ONLY to Indian citizens?
qh: कौन से मौलिक अधिकार केवल भारतीय नागरिकों को उपलब्ध हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Kuch rights 'Universal' hain aur kuch 'Exclusive'. \\n2. Logic: Articles 15, 16, 19, 29, aur 30 videshiyo (foreigners) ko nahi milte. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 21 (Life) videshiyo ko bhi milta hai kyunki wo ek human right hai.

qe: The 'Right to Education' (RTE) was added by which amendment?
qh: 'शिक्षा का अधिकार' किस संशोधन द्वारा जोड़ा गया था?
e: 1. Core Concept: RTE ko Article 21A mein dala gaya. \\n2. Logic: 6 se 14 saal ke bacchon ko 'Free & Compulsory Education' milna unka mool adhikar hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise saal 2002 mein Atal Bihari Vajpayee sarkar ne pass kiya tha.

qe: Article 18 deals with the 'Abolition of Titles'. Which titles are allowed?
qh: अनुच्छेद 18 'उपाधियों के अंत' से संबंधित है। कौन सी उपाधियाँ मान्य हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Iska maksad 'Social Hierarchy' ko khatam karna hai. \\n2. Logic: Colonel, Major ya Doctor, PhD jaisi titles lagayi ja sakti hain kyunki ye 'Merit' par milti hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Bharat Ratna ya Padma Awards 'Titles' nahi hain, wo 'Honours' (Samman) hain.

qe: What is the 'Doctrine of Eclipse' mentioned in Article 13?
qh: अनुच्छेद 13 में वर्णित 'आच्छादन का सिद्धांत' (Doctrine of Eclipse) क्या है?
o: Pre-constitutional laws become dormant if they violate FR (मौलिक अधिकारों का उल्लंघन करने पर पुराने कानून सुप्त हो जाते हैं)
Supreme Court can make new laws
e: 1. Core Concept: Samvidhan aane se pehle ke kanoon (Pre-Constitutional) agar Rights ke khilaaf hain, toh wo khatam nahi hote, bas 'Shadow' (Eclipse) mein chale jate hain. \\n2. Logic: Agar future mein wo Right hata diya jaye, toh wo kanoon fir se zinda ho sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye principle 'Bhikaji vs State of MP' case mein establish hua tha.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Suspension of Article 19' automatically during National Emergency?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान अनुच्छेद 19 के स्वतः निलंबन का प्रावधान कौन सा अनुच्छेद करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Emergency lagte hi Speech aur Expression ki azadi par sabse pehle asar padta hai. \\n2. Logic: Article 358 kehta hai ki agar 'War' ya 'External Aggression' ki wajah se emergency lagi hai, toh Article 19 apne aap suspend ho jayega. \\n3. Extra Fact: Lekin 'Armed Rebellion' (aantarik vidroh) ke waqt ye apne aap suspend nahi hota.

qe: The writ of 'Prohibition' is issued by a Higher Court to a Lower Court to:
qh: 'प्रतिषेध' (Prohibition) रिट एक उच्च न्यायालय द्वारा निचले न्यायालय को क्यों जारी की जाती है?
o: To stop proceedings that exceed jurisdiction (अधिकार क्षेत्र से बाहर की कार्यवाही को रोकने के लिए)
e: 1. Core Concept: Ise 'Stay Order' ki tarah samjhein. \\n2. Logic: Jab lower court apne power se bahar ja kar kaam karta hai, toh higher court use wahi 'Stop' kar deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Prohibition' tab nikalti hai jab case chal raha ho, aur 'Certiorari' tab jab faisla aa chuka ho.

qe: Which case established that Fundamental Rights and DPSP are 'Two wheels of a chariot'?
qh: किस मामले में कहा गया कि मौलिक अधिकार और DPSP 'एक रथ के दो पहिये' हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Rights aur Welfare dono ka balance zaroori hai. \\n2. Logic: 1980 ke Minerva Mills case mein SC ne kaha ki Part III aur Part IV ke beech 'Harmony' honi chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Is case ne 42nd Amendment ke us badlav ko radd kiya jisne DPSP ko Rights se upar rakha tha.

qe: Article 15(4) and 15(5) provide for reservation in educational institutions. They were added by which amendments?
qh: अनुच्छेद 15(4) और 15(5) शिक्षा संस्थानों में आरक्षण का प्रावधान करते हैं। इन्हें किन संशोधनों द्वारा जोड़ा गया?
e: 1. Core Concept: Samvidhan mein reservation pehle se nahi tha, ise baad mein zaroorat ke hisab se joda gaya. \\n2. Logic: 1st Amendment (1951) ne SC/ST ke liye aur 93rd (2005) ne OBC ke liye rasta khola. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 15(6) EWS reservation ke liye 103rd Amendment se joda gaya.

qe: The 'Creamy Layer' concept for OBC reservation was introduced following which case?
qh: OBC आरक्षण के लिए 'क्रीमी लेयर' की अवधारणा किस मामले के बाद पेश की गई थी?
e: 1. Core Concept: Arakshan ka labh unhe mile jo sach mein pichde hain. \\n2. Logic: 1992 ke Indra Sawhney case (Mandal case) mein SC ne kaha ki amir OBCs ko reservation nahi milna chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Is faisle ne total reservation ki limit 50% par fix kar di thi.

qe: Article 20(3) says 'No person shall be compelled to be a witness against himself'. This is called:
qh: अनुच्छेद 20(3) कहता है 'किसी को अपने खिलाफ गवाह बनने के लिए मजबूर नहीं किया जाएगा'। इसे क्या कहते हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Police custody mein torture karke kaboolnama karwana galat hai. \\n2. Logic: Koi bhi court police ke samne diye gaye bayan ko tab tak nahi manta jab tak gawah magistrate ke samne na bole. \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Narco Analysis' aur 'Polygraph' test bhi isi Article ke khilaaf mane jate hain (Selvi Case).

qe: What is 'Preventive Detention' under Article 22?
qh: अनुच्छेद 22 के तहत 'निवारक निरोध' क्या है?
o: Detention before crime to prevent it (जुर्म होने से पहले उसे रोकने के लिए हिरासत)
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye 'Shak' (suspicion) ke adhar par arrest hai. \\n2. Logic: Agar sarkar ko lage ki koi dange bhadka sakta hai ya desh ki suraksha khatre mein dal sakta hai, toh use pehle hi arrest kiya ja sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Bina trial ke aisi custody 3 mahine tak ho sakti hai (Advisory Board ki permission ke bina).

qe: Article 13(2) is the power behind 'Judicial Review'. What does it say?
qh: अनुच्छेद 13(2) 'न्यायिक समीक्षा' की शक्ति है। यह क्या कहता है?
o: Any law inconsistent with FR shall be void (अधिकारों के खिलाफ कोई भी कानून शून्य होगा)
e: 1. Core Concept: Judiciary kanoon ko check kar sakti hai. \\n2. Logic: Agar Sansad aisa kanoon banati hai jo Rights ko cheenta hai, toh Supreme Court use Article 13 ke tehat khatam kar sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Judicial Review' ka concept humne USA ke Samvidhan se liya hai.

qe: The 'Right to Strike' is not a Fundamental Right, but what about 'Right to Protest'?
qh: 'हड़ताल' मौलिक अधिकार नहीं है, लेकिन 'विरोध प्रदर्शन' (Protest) का अधिकार क्या है?
o: It is a Fundamental Right under Art 19 (अनुच्छेद 19 के तहत मौलिक अधिकार)
e: 1. Core Concept: Shantipurn virodh loktantra ki pehchan hai. \\n2. Logic: Bina hathiyaro ke 'Assemble' hona aur apni baat kehna Article 19(1)(a) aur (b) ka hissa hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Lekin ye protest shantipurn (Peaceful) hona chahiye aur 'Public Order' ko nuksan nahi pahunchana chahiye.

qe: Article 31C was added to give precedence to which DPSPs over Fundamental Rights?
qh: अनुच्छेद 31C किन DPSP को मौलिक अधिकारों पर प्राथमिकता देने के लिए जोड़ा गया था?
e: 1. Core Concept: Wealth distribution aur resources ka management Rights se upar rakha gaya. \\n2. Logic: Ise 25th Amendment (1971) se joda gaya taaki garibi hatane ke kanoon ko court mein challenge na kiya ja sake. \\n3. Extra Fact: SC ne Kesavananda Case mein iska ek hissa radd kar diya tha jo Judicial Review cheenta tha.

qe: Which Article allows the President to issue an 'Order' to specify which tribes are 'Scheduled Tribes'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद राष्ट्रपति को यह निर्दिष्ट करने की अनुमति देता है कि कौन सी जनजातियां 'अनुसूचित जनजाति' हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Reservation ka base isi definition se banta hai. \\n2. Logic: Bina specific list ke Article 15(4) aur 16(4) ke labh nahi diye ja sakte. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 341 'Scheduled Castes' (SC) ke liye hai aur 342 'ST' ke liye.

qe: What is 'Office of Profit' in relation to Fundamental Rights?
qh: मौलिक अधिकारों के संबंध में 'लाभ का पद' क्या है?
o: A government position that gives financial benefit (सरकारी पद जो वित्तीय लाभ देता है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Independence of Legislature. \\n2. Logic: Iska zikr Article 102 aur 191 mein hai, par ye Rights ko isliye affect karta hai kyunki 'State' ki definition (Art 12) ispar nirbhar karti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Jaya Bachchan case iska ek famous example hai.

qe: Article 33 gives Parliament power to modify rights for:
qh: अनुच्छेद 33 संसद को किसके लिए अधिकारों को संशोधित करने की शक्ति देता है?
o: Members of Armed Forces (सशस्त्र बलों के सदस्य)
e: 1. Core Concept: National Security vs individual rights. \\n2. Logic: In organizations mein 'Discipline' sabse upar hai. Agar ye log strike karein ya media mein jayein, toh desh khatre mein pad sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Is kanoon ko kisi bhi court mein Rights ke violation ke naam par challenge nahi kiya ja sakta.

qe: The concept of 'Procedure Established by Law' is taken from?
qh: 'कानून द्वारा स्थापित प्रक्रिया' की अवधारणा कहाँ से ली गई है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 21 ki wording. \\n2. Logic: Iska matlab hai ki police wahi karegi jo kanoon ki kitab mein likha hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Maneka Gandhi case ke baad India ne USA ka 'Due Process of Law' bhi apnaya, jiska matlab hai kanoon sirf likha nahi hona chahiye, 'Fair' bhi hona chahiye.

qe: Article 16(4A) provides for 'Reservation in Promotion' for SC/ST. It was added by:
qh: अनुच्छेद 16(4A) SC/ST के लिए 'पदोन्नति में आरक्षण' प्रदान करता है। इसे किसके द्वारा जोड़ा गया?
e: 1. Core Concept: Sirf naukri milna kaafi nahi, career mein aage badhne mein bhi barabari. \\n2. Logic: 1995 mein ise joda gaya taaki Indra Sawhney case ke us rule ko badla ja sake jahan promotion mein reservation mana tha. \\n3. Extra Fact: 85th Amendment ne isme 'Consequential Seniority' word bhi add kiya.

qe: Which Article deals with the enforcement of FR through laws made by Parliament?
qh: मौलिक अधिकारों को प्रभावी बनाने के लिए संसद द्वारा बनाए गए कानूनों से कौन सा अनुच्छेद संबंधित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Uniformity across India. \\n2. Logic: Agar State Assemblies rights ke kanoon banayengi toh Bihar mein alag aur Kerala mein alag kanoon honge. Ise rokne ke liye power sirf Sansad ko di gayi. \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Untouchability Act' aur 'Child Labor Prohibition Act' isi Article ke tehat bane hain.

qe: What is the 'Doctrine of Severability' in Article 13?
qh: अनुच्छेद 13 में 'पृथक्करणीयता का सिद्धांत' (Doctrine of Severability) क्या है?
o: Only the invalid part of law becomes void (कानून का केवल अवैध हिस्सा शून्य हो जाता है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Pure kanoon ko radd karne ki zaroorat nahi agar problem sirf ek line mein hai. \\n2. Logic: Agar kanoon ka ganda part saaf part se alag kiya ja sakta hai, toh sirf ganda part hi radd hoga. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Doctrine of Separability' bhi kehte hain.

qe: Article 29 protects the interest of:
qh: अनुच्छेद 29 किसके हितों की रक्षा करता है?
o: Any section of citizens (नागरिकों का कोई भी वर्ग)
e: 1. Core Concept: 'Minority' word heading mein hai, par text mein 'Section of Citizens' hai. \\n2. Logic: Iska matlab hai ki Majority group bhi agar apni bhasha ya culture bachana chahe, toh Article 29 unki madad karega. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 30 sirf Minorities ke liye hai, par 29 sabke liye ho sakta hai.

qe: What is the difference between 'Prohibition' and 'Certiorari' writs?
qh: 'प्रतिषेध' और 'उत्प्रेषण' रिट के बीच क्या अंतर है?
o: Prohibition is preventive, Certiorari is curative (प्रतिषेध निवारक है, उत्प्रेषण सुधारात्मक है)
Prohibition is for public, Certiorari for private
e: 1. Core Concept: Dono lower courts ko control karne ke liye hain. \\n2. Logic: 'Prohibition' tab jari hoti hai jab case chal raha ho (stop karne ke liye), aur 'Certiorari' tab jab faisla aa chuka ho (usse radd karne ke liye). \\n3. Extra Fact: Certiorari ka upyog ab administrative authorities ke khilaaf bhi kiya ja sakta hai.

qe: Article 30 gives Minorities the right to establish educational institutions. Does it include 'Recognition' by the State?
qh: अनुच्छेद 30 अल्पसंख्यकों को संस्थान खोलने का हक देता है। क्या इसमें राज्य द्वारा 'मान्यता' भी शामिल है?
o: Yes, it is an absolute right
No, recognition is subject to state standards (नहीं, मान्यता राज्य के मानकों के अधीन है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Rights vs Regulation. \\n2. Logic: Minorities apna school toh khol sakte hain, lekin degree aur syllabus ke liye unhe Sarkar ke rules (health, sanitation, academic standards) manne honge. \\n3. Extra Fact: Bina standards ke di gayi 'Recognition' ko Rights ka violation nahi mana jata.

qe: Which Article protects the 'Script and Language' of a section of citizens?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद नागरिकों के किसी वर्ग की 'लिपि और भाषा' की रक्षा करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Cultural identity ka sanrakshan. \\n2. Logic: Ye sirf dharam nahi, balki 'Linguistic' (bhashayi) groups ko bhi unki virasat bachane ka adhikar deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Is article ka labh Majority groups (jaise Hindi bhashi) bhi le sakte hain agar wo kisi area mein minority mein hain.

qe: What is the 'Doctrine of Waiver' in the context of Indian Fundamental Rights?
qh: भारतीय मौलिक अधिकारों के संदर्भ में 'त्याग का सिद्धांत' (Doctrine of Waiver) क्या है?
o: A person can give up their rights
A person CANNOT give up their rights (कोई अपने अधिकारों का त्याग नहीं कर सकता)
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitution supreme hai, insaan ki marzi nahi. \\n2. Logic: USA mein log rights chhod sakte hain, par India mein koi nagrik ye nahi keh sakta ki 'Mujhe Article 21 nahi chahiye'. \\n3. Extra Fact: Behram Khurshed Case mein SC ne kaha ki Rights public policy ka hissa hain, unhe waive nahi kiya ja sakta.

qe: Can the Parliament empower 'Local Courts' to issue Writs under Article 32?
qh: क्या संसद अनुच्छेद 32 के तहत 'स्थानीय न्यायालयों' को रिट जारी करने की शक्ति दे सकती है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Decentralization of Justice. \\n2. Logic: Article 32(3) kehta hai ki Sansad kanoon banakar kisi bhi court ko ye power de sakti hai, halanki abhi tak aisa kanoon nahi bana hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Filhal sirf Supreme Court (Art 32) aur High Courts (Art 226) ke paas ye power hai.

qe: Which Fundamental Right is described as a 'Natural Right' that exists even without a Constitution?
qh: किस मौलिक अधिकार को 'प्राकृतिक अधिकार' कहा जाता है जो संविधान के बिना भी मौजूद रहता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Rights of Humanity. \\n2. Logic: Jeene ka adhikar (Right to Life) kudrati hai. Samvidhan use 'deta' nahi hai, balki sirf 'protect' karta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isi wajah se Emergency mein bhi ise radd nahi kiya ja sakta.

qe: Article 13(3) defines 'Law'. Does it include 'Customs and Usages'?
qh: अनुच्छेद 13(3) 'कानून' को परिभाषित करता है। क्या इसमें 'प्रथाएं और रीति-रिवाज' शामिल हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Law ki broad definition. \\n2. Logic: Agar koi purani pratha (Custom) Rights ke khilaaf hai, toh use kanoon ki tarah hi void (zero) mana jayega. \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Sati Pratha' ya 'Triple Talaq' jaise cases isi logic par radd kiye gaye kyunki wo Rights ke khilaaf the.

qe: What is the 'Rule of Law' (कानून का शासन) as per Article 14?
qh: अनुच्छेद 14 के अनुसार 'कानून का शासन' क्या है?
o: Absence of arbitrary power (निरंकुश शक्ति का अभाव)
e: 1. Core Concept: A.V. Dicey ka principle. \\n2. Logic: Koi bhi insaan kanoon se upar nahi hai aur sarkar apni marzi se kisi ko saza nahi de sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Rule of Law' ko Samvidhan ka 'Basic Structure' mana gaya hai.

qe: Under Article 19, 'Freedom of Association' includes the right NOT to join an association.
qh: अनुच्छेद 19 के तहत, 'संघ बनाने की स्वतंत्रता' में संघ में शामिल न होने का अधिकार भी शामिल है।
e: 1. Core Concept: Negative aspect of Liberty. \\n2. Logic: Azadi ka matlab ye bhi hai ki aapko kisi group ya party mein zabardasti shamil nahi kiya ja sakta. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme 'Right to form Co-operative Societies' bhi 97th Amendment se joda gaya hai.

qe: Article 20(1) protects against 'Ex-post facto laws'. This means:
qh: अनुच्छेद 20(1) 'पूर्वव्यापी कानूनों' से बचाता है। इसका अर्थ है:
o: No punishment for an act that was NOT a crime when committed (किया गया कार्य तब अपराध नहीं था, तो सजा नहीं)
e: 1. Core Concept: Retroactive criminal laws pe rok. \\n2. Logic: Agar aaj koi kaam kanooni hai, aur kal sarkar use jurm bana de, toh aapko aaj ke kaam ke liye kal saza nahi mil sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye sirf 'Criminal' kanoon par lagu hota hai, 'Tax' ya 'Civil' kanoon par nahi.

qe: Which Article prohibits the 'Religious Instruction' in educational institutions fully funded by the State?
qh: राज्य द्वारा पूरी तरह से वित्तपोषित संस्थानों में 'धार्मिक शिक्षा' पर कौन सा अनुच्छेद रोक लगाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Secular nature of public education. \\n2. Logic: Sarkari paisa sabka hai, isliye wahan kisi ek dharam ki padhai nahi ho sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Private schools jo sarkari help (aid) lete hain, wahan prarthna (prayer) mein baithna bacche ki marzi par nirbhar hai.

qe: Article 16(4B) deals with 'Carry Forward Rule' in reservation. What is it?
qh: अनुच्छेद 16(4B) आरक्षण में 'कैरी फॉरवर्ड रूल' से संबंधित है। यह क्या है?
o: Filling unfilled SC/ST seats in next year (SC/ST की खाली सीटों को अगले साल भरना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Backlog vacancies ko bharna. \\n2. Logic: Agar is saal SC/ST ki seats khali reh gayi, toh wo agle saal ki seats mein jud jayengi aur 50% ki limit ko cross kar sakti hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 81st Amendment Act (2000) dwara joda gaya tha.

qe: Can a person be deprived of their life or personal liberty without any procedure?
qh: क्या किसी व्यक्ति को बिना किसी प्रक्रिया के उसके जीवन या व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता से वंचित किया जा सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 21 ki suraksha. \\n2. Logic: Kisi ko bhi jail bhejne ya saza dene ke liye 'Law' aur 'Fair Procedure' ka hona zaroori hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Maneka Gandhi case mein kaha gaya ki ye procedure 'Just, Fair aur Reasonable' hona chahiye.

qe: Article 24 is an 'Absolute' prohibition. Does it have any exceptions like Article 15?
qh: अनुच्छेद 24 एक 'पूर्ण' निषेध है। क्या इसमें अनुच्छेद 15 की तरह कोई अपवाद हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Child Labor se zero tolerance. \\n2. Logic: 14 saal se kam ke bacche ko 'Hazardous' (khatarnak) kamo mein kisi bhi halat mein nahi lagaya ja sakta. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye right Article 17 (Untouchability) ki tarah absolute hai.

qe: Which Article provides the right to 'Move the Supreme Court' by appropriate proceedings?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद उचित कार्यवाही द्वारा 'सुप्रीम कोर्ट जाने' का अधिकार देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Right to Constitutional Remedies. \\n2. Logic: Ye right apne aap mein ek Fundamental Right hai, isliye SC ise mana nahi kar sakta. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise Samvidhan ka 'Protective Umbrella' (suraksha chhatri) bhi kehte hain.

qe: The power of Parliament to amend Fundamental Rights was challenged in which case first?
qh: मौलिक अधिकारों में संशोधन की संसद की शक्ति को सबसे पहले किस मामले में चुनौती दी गई थी?
e: 1. Core Concept: Amendment power vs FR conflict. \\n2. Logic: 1951 ke Shankari Prasad case mein SC ne pehli baar mana ki Parliament Rights ko badal sakti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Lekin baad mein Golaknath case (1967) mein SC ne is faisle ko ulat diya tha.

qe: What is the 'Hebeas Corpus' writ used for?
qh: 'बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण' रिट का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
o: To release a person from illegal detention (अवैध हिरासत से व्यक्ति को छुड़ाने के लिए)
e: 1. Core Concept: Personal Liberty ka rakshak. \\n2. Logic: Agar police ya koi private insaan kisi ko bina wajah band rakhe, toh Court use pesh karne ka order deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: ADM Jabalpur case (Emergency) mein is writ par bahut badi behes hui thi.

qe: Article 15(6) and 16(6) provide 10% reservation for EWS. This was added by:
qh: अनुच्छेद 15(6) और 16(6) EWS के लिए 10% आरक्षण देते हैं। इसे जोड़ा गया था:
e: 1. Core Concept: Economic based reservation. \\n2. Logic: Pehli baar 'Garibi' (Economy) ko reservation ka base banaya gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 2019 mein laya gaya aur is par Janhit Abhiyan case mein SC ne mohar lagayi.

qe: Which Article restricts Fundamental Rights while 'Martial Law' is in force in any area?
qh: किसी भी क्षेत्र में 'मार्शल लॉ' लागू होने पर कौन सा अनुच्छेद मौलिक अधिकारों को प्रतिबंधित करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Military rule aur Rights ka takrav. \\n2. Logic: Martial Law ke waqt aam kanoon suspend ho jate hain aur Army ka kanoon chalta hai, isliye Rights par rok lagti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Martial Law ka concept English Common Law se liya gaya hai.

qe: Article 13(1) deals with 'Pre-constitutional' laws. If they violate FR, they are void to the extent of:
qh: अनुच्छेद 13(1) पुराने कानूनों से संबंधित है। यदि वे अधिकारों का उल्लंघन करते हैं, तो वे किस हद तक शून्य होंगे?
o: Only the inconsistent part is void (केवल असंगत हिस्सा शून्य होगा)
Only for the person who files case
e: 1. Core Concept: Partial invalidity. \\n2. Logic: Agar ek poore kanoon mein sirf ek line galat hai, toh poora kanoon khatam karne ki zaroorat nahi hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Doctrine of Severability' kehte hain.

qe: Does the 'Right to Life' (Article 21) include the 'Right to Die'?
qh: क्या 'जीवन के अधिकार' (अनुच्छेद 21) में 'मरने का अधिकार' शामिल है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Right to Life is positive. \\n2. Logic: Gian Kaur case mein SC ne kaha ki 'Jeene ke adhikar' mein 'Marna' shamil nahi hai. Suicide jurm mana gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Lekin 'Passive Euthanasia' (dardnak bimari mein ilaaj rokna) ko ab limited sharto par allow kiya gaya hai (Common Cause Case).

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Abolition of Titles' like Maharaja, Rai Bahadur?
qh: महाराजा, राय बहादुर जैसी 'उपाधियों के अंत' का प्रावधान कौन सा अनुच्छेद करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Social Equality aur Democracy. \\n2. Logic: Ek loktantra mein sab barabar hain, koi janam se 'Maharaja' nahi ho sakta. \\n3. Extra Fact: Education aur Defense ki degrees lagayi ja sakti hain kyunki wo 'Earn' ki jati hain.

qe: Article 26 gives rights to religious denominations. Does it include the right to 'Own Property'?
qh: अनुच्छेद 26 धार्मिक संप्रदायों को अधिकार देता है। क्या इसमें 'संपत्ति रखने' का अधिकार शामिल है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Collective Religious Freedom. \\n2. Logic: Dharamik sansthayein zameen kharid sakti hain aur trust chala sakti hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Lekin unhe is property ko 'Law' (kanoon) ke hisab se hi manage karna hoga.

qe: The Supreme Court widened the scope of Article 21 in which famous case related to 'Foreign Travel'?
qh: 'विदेश यात्रा' से संबंधित किस मामले में सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने अनुच्छेद 21 का दायरा बढ़ाया?
e: 1. Core Concept: Liberty ka naya matlab. \\n2. Logic: Court ne kaha ki Videsh jana 'Personal Liberty' hai aur sarkar bina valid reason ke passport nahi cheen sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isi case ne 'Golden Triangle' (Art 14, 19, 21) ka concept diya.

qe: The writ of 'Mandamus' literally means 'We Command'. Who does it command?
qh: 'परमादेश' रिट का अर्थ है 'हम आदेश देते हैं'। यह किसे आदेश देता है?
o: A public official to perform duty (कर्तव्य निभाने के लिए सार्वजनिक अधिकारी को)
e: 1. Core Concept: Accountability of Govt officers. \\n2. Logic: Agar koi officer apna kanooni kaam karne se mana kare, toh Court use order deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye kisi 'Private' insaan ke khilaaf nahi nikali ja sakti.

qe: Article 32 is a 'Basic Structure' of the Constitution. Can it be taken away by amendment?
qh: अनुच्छेद 32 संविधान की 'मूल संरचना' है। क्या इसे संशोधन द्वारा हटाया जा सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Protection is essential. \\n2. Logic: Agar Rights bachane wala Article hi khatam ho gaya, toh Rights ka koi matlab nahi rahega. \\n3. Extra Fact: SC ne Minerva Mills case mein iski pushti ki thi.

qe: Which Article provides protection against 'Self-Incrimination'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'स्व-दोषारोपण' (खुद के खिलाफ गवाही) से सुरक्षा देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Right to remain silent. \\n2. Logic: Kisi ko majboor nahi kiya ja sakta ki wo apne hi khilaaf gawah bane. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye sirf 'Criminal' cases mein milta hai, civil enquiry mein nahi.

qe: The 'Cultural Rights' in Article 29 are for 'Any section of citizens'. Does it include the Majority?
qh: अनुच्छेद 29 में 'सांस्कृतिक अधिकार' नागरिकों के किसी भी वर्ग के लिए हैं। क्या इसमें बहुमत शामिल है?
e: 1. Core Concept: General protection of culture. \\n2. Logic: Halanki ye Minority section mein hai, par wording 'Any Section' hai, isliye Majority group bhi apna culture bachane ke liye ise use kar sakte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Supreme Court ne 'T.M.A. Pai' case mein ise saaf kiya tha.

qe: Article 15 prohibits discrimination on grounds of 'Place of Birth'. Does it also include 'Residence'?
qh: अनुच्छेद 15 'जन्म स्थान' के आधार पर भेदभाव रोकता है। क्या इसमें 'निवास' (Residence) भी शामिल है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Birthplace vs Residence difference. \\n2. Logic: States 'Residence' (Domicile) ke adhar par college admission mein suvidha de sakti hain, ye Article 15 ka violation nahi hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 16 (Jobs) mein 'Residence' ke adhar par bhedbhav par rok hai, par 15 mein nahi.

qe: What is the 'Quo-Warranto' writ used to check?
qh: 'अधिकार पृच्छा' रिट का उपयोग क्या जाँचने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Legality of a claim to a public office (सार्वजनिक पद पर दावे की वैधता)
e: 1. Core Concept: Qualification of officers. \\n2. Logic: Agar koi insaan bina qualification ke kisi sarkari kursi par baith jaye, toh Court puchta hai 'Kis adhikar se?'. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye akeli aisi writ hai jo koi bhi nagrik (bhale hi wo peedit na ho) file kar sakta hai.

qe: Which Fundamental Right is also known as the 'Right to Freedom of Religion'?
qh: किस मौलिक अधिकार को 'धार्मिक स्वतंत्रता का अधिकार' भी कहा जाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Secularism ka action part. \\n2. Logic: Isme individually dharam manna, prachar karna aur sansthayein chalana shamil hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Rights India ke 'Secular' character ko define karte hain.

qe: The Supreme Court can issue Writs for Fundamental Rights, but High Courts can issue them for?
qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट अधिकारों के लिए रिट जारी कर सकता है, लेकिन हाई कोर्ट किसके लिए?
o: FR and any other legal purpose (FR और अन्य कानूनी उद्देश्य)
e: 1. Core Concept: High Court ka writ area bada hai. \\n2. Logic: Article 226 ke andar High Court rights ke alawa normal kanooni bhedbhav par bhi writ nikal sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isliye writ jurisdiction mein High Court, Supreme Court se zyada 'Wide' (vrit) hai.

qe: Article 17 prohibits 'Untouchability'. Is the word defined in the Constitution?
qh: अनुच्छेद 17 'अस्पृश्यता' को रोकता है। क्या यह शब्द संविधान में परिभाषित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Use without definition. \\n2. Logic: Samvidhan mein ise define nahi kiya gaya, par Courts ne mana hai ki ye 'Caste based' bhedbhav hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Mysore High Court ne kaha ki ye 'Social Practice' hai, literal untouchability nahi.

qe: Which Fundamental Right provides 'Right against Exploitation' specifically to children?
qh: कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार विशेष रूप से बच्चों को 'शोषण के खिलाफ अधिकार' प्रदान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Protection of Childhood. \\n2. Logic: 14 saal se kam ke bacchon ko factory, mine ya khatarnak kamo mein lagane par rok hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Article baccho ke 'Health' ko protect karta hai.

qe: Article 19(1)(c) gives the right to form Unions. Does it include 'Right to Recognition' of that Union?
qh: अनुच्छेद 19(1)(c) संघ बनाने का अधिकार देता है। क्या इसमें संघ को 'मान्यता' मिलने का अधिकार भी है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Formation vs Recognition. \\n2. Logic: Aap union bana sakte hain, par sarkar ko majboor nahi kar sakte ki wo use 'Recognize' kare ya usse baat kare. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'All India Bank Employees' case mein saaf kiya gaya tha.

qe: The writ of 'Prohibition' can be issued against Administrative authorities.
qh: 'प्रतिषेध' रिट प्रशासनिक अधिकारियों के खिलाफ जारी की जा सकती है।
e: 1. Core Concept: Limitation of Prohibition. \\n2. Logic: Prohibition sirf 'Judicial' aur 'Quasi-judicial' bodies ke khilaaf nikalti hai, normal officers ke khilaaf nahi. \\n3. Extra Fact: Certiorari ab administrative bodies ke khilaaf bhi nikal sakti hai, par Prohibition nahi.

qe: Article 14 provides 'Equal Protection of Laws'. This concept is taken from?
qh: अनुच्छेद 14 'कानूनों का समान संरक्षण' प्रदान करता है। यह अवधारणा कहाँ से ली गई है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Positive Equality. \\n2. Logic: Iska matlab hai ki 'Saman logo ke sath saman vyavhar' (Like should be treated alike). \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Equality Before Law' Britain se liya gaya hai (Negative concept).

qe: Can the Supreme Court issue a writ to the Parliament to make a law?
qh: क्या सुप्रीम कोर्ट संसद को कानून बनाने के लिए रिट जारी कर सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Separation of Powers. \\n2. Logic: Kanoon banana Sansad ka kaam hai. Court kanoon check kar sakta hai, par banane ka order nahi de sakta. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Judicial Restraint' kehte hain.

qe: Article 22 protects against detention. Does it apply to 'Enemy Aliens'?
qh: अनुच्छेद 22 हिरासत के खिलाफ सुरक्षा देता है। क्या यह 'शत्रु अन्यदेशीय' (Enemy Aliens) पर लागू होता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Security exceptions. \\n2. Logic: Jo log dushman desh se hain, unhe Article 22 ki safety (24 ghante mein magistrate ke samne pesh hona) nahi milti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Preventive Detention wale logo par bhi poori tarah lagu nahi hota.

qe: Which Fundamental Right provides for 'Equality of Status and Opportunity' specifically in Public Employment?
qh: कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार विशेष रूप से सरकारी नौकरियों में समानता प्रदान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Fair job competition. \\n2. Logic: Sarkari naukri pane mein bhedbhav nahi hoga. \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Residence' ke adhar par Sansad chahe toh reservation de sakti hai (Article 16(3)).

qe: What is 'Judicial Review' in Article 13?
qh: अनुच्छेद 13 में 'न्यायिक समीक्षा' क्या है?
o: Checking if laws follow the Constitution (जाँचना कि कानून संविधान का पालन करते हैं)
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitution ki supremacy. \\n2. Logic: Court kanoon ko check karta hai, agar wo Rights ke khilaaf hai toh use 'Zero' kar deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye power Courts ko Samvidhan ka asli 'Caretaker' banati hai.

qe: Can Fundamental Rights be suspended during an Emergency under Article 359?
qh: क्या अनुच्छेद 359 के तहत आपातकाल के दौरान अधिकारों को निलंबित किया जा सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Suspension of enforcement. \\n2. Logic: Article 359 kehta hai ki President order de sakta hai ki aap rights ke liye Court nahi ja sakte. \\n3. Extra Fact: Lekin Art 20 aur 21 ko phir bhi suspend nahi kiya ja sakta.

qe: Article 21A (Right to Education) was recommended by which committee?
qh: अनुच्छेद 21A की सिफारिश किस समिति ने की थी?
e: 1. Core Concept: Education as a Right. \\n2. Logic: Is committee ne 6-14 saal ke bacchon ke liye free education ki report di thi. \\n3. Extra Fact: Pehle ye sirf 'DPSP' (Art 45) mein tha.

qe: What is the 'Doctrine of Pith and Substance'?
qh: 'सार और तत्व का सिद्धांत' (Doctrine of Pith and Substance) क्या है?
o: Looking at the real intent of a law (कानून के वास्तविक उद्देश्य को देखना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Law ki asliyat pehchanna. \\n2. Logic: Agar koi kanoon galti se dusre subject ko touch karta hai, toh court dekhta hai ki uska asli 'Pith' (maksad) kya hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 7th Schedule ke subjects ki takrav mein use hota hai.

qe: Article 15(4) was added after which Supreme Court case?
qh: अनुच्छेद 15(4) किस सुप्रीम कोर्ट मामले के बाद जोड़ा गया था?
e: 1. Core Concept: Reservation ki kanooni shuruat. \\n2. Logic: Jab SC ne caste-based reservation ko radd kar diya, toh Sansad ne 1st Amendment se Article 15(4) joda. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye pehla amendment tha Samvidhan banane ke turant baad.

qe: Which Article allows for 'Abolition of Untouchability'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'अस्पृश्यता के अंत' का प्रावधान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Social Reform. \\n2. Logic: Ye right 'State' aur 'Private' dono ke khilaaf hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Chhua-chhoot karna kanoonan jurm hai aur iske liye jail ho sakti hai.

qe: The writ of 'Certiorari' can be issued against which authorities?
qh: 'उत्प्रेषण' रिट किन अधिकारियों के खिलाफ जारी की जा सकती है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Widening of writ power. \\n2. Logic: Pehle ye sirf courts ke liye thi, par 1991 ke baad ye officers ke faislo ko radd karne ke liye bhi use hone lagi. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'Error of Law' ko theek karne ke liye best hai.

qe: Article 23 prohibits 'Human Trafficking'. Does it include prostitution?
qh: अनुच्छेद 23 'मानव तस्करी' को रोकता है। क्या इसमें वेश्यावृत्ति शामिल है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Protection of Human Dignity. \\n2. Logic: Insaano ko bazaar mein bechna ya unethical kamo mein lagana trafficking ka hissa hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Sita Act' (PITA) isi Article ko lagu karne ke liye bana hai.

qe: Can the 'Basic Structure' of Fundamental Rights be destroyed by the President?
qh: क्या राष्ट्रपति मौलिक अधिकारों की 'मूल संरचना' को नष्ट कर सकते हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitution's Supreme Protection. \\n2. Logic: Basic structure ko koi nahi chhu sakta, chahe wo Sansad ho ya Rashtrapati. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise Kesavananda case ke baad 'Impenetrable' (na-tootne wala) mana gaya hai.

qe: Which Fundamental Right provides for 'Equality of Status and Opportunity' in Preamble?
qh: कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार प्रस्तावना में 'प्रतिष्ठा और अवसर की समानता' प्रदान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Rights to Equality. \\n2. Logic: Ye 5 Articles (14 se 18) milkar bhedbhav khatam karke sabko barabar status dete hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Democracy ki pehli shart hai.

qe: The writ of 'Mandamus' cannot be issued against a Private Individual.
qh: 'परमादेश' (Mandamus) रिट एक निजी व्यक्ति के खिलाफ जारी नहीं की जा सकती।
e: 1. Core Concept: Mandamus sirf 'Public Duty' ke liye hai. \\n2. Logic: Ye sirf unke khilaaf nikalti hai jo sarkari kursi par baithe hain aur apna kaam nahi kar rahe. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye President ya Governor ke khilaaf bhi nahi nikalti.

qe: In which case did SC rule that 'Article 21 includes the Right to Sleep'?
qh: किस मामले में SC ने फैसला सुनाया कि 'अनुच्छेद 21 में सोने का अधिकार शामिल है'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Life ka matlab sirf saans lena nahi, 'Dignified Life' hai. \\n2. Logic: Neend (Sleep) insaan ki basic health ke liye zaroori hai. Bina wajah kisi ki neend kharab karna Rights ka violation hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye faisla Baba Ramdev ke protest par raat mein hui police karwai ke baad aaya tha.

qe: The 'Habeas Corpus' writ can be issued against both Public and Private individuals.
qh: 'बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण' रिट सार्वजनिक और निजी दोनों व्यक्तियों के खिलाफ जारी की जा सकती है।
e: 1. Core Concept: Illegal detention kisi bhi tarah ki ho, use khatam karna hai. \\n2. Logic: Agar police ne band kiya hai toh bhi, aur agar kisi gunde ya rishtedar ne kamre mein band kiya hai toh bhi, ye Writ kaam karegi. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye akeli aisi writ hai jo private logo ke khilaaf bhi kaam karti hai.

qe: Article 14 prohibits 'Class Legislation' but allows 'Reasonable Classification'. What does it mean?
qh: अनुच्छेद 14 'वर्ग विधान' को रोकता है लेकिन 'उचित वर्गीकरण' की अनुमति देता है। इसका क्या अर्थ है?
o: Laws should be same for everyone always
Different laws for different groups based on logic (तर्क के आधार पर अलग-अलग समूहों के लिए अलग कानून)
e: 1. Core Concept: 'Equals should be treated equally'. \\n2. Logic: Ek bache aur ek bade par ek jaisa tax nahi lag sakta. Groups banana 'Reasonable' (tark-sangat) hona chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Classification ka base 'Intelligible Differentia' hona chahiye.

qe: Which Fundamental Right provides for 'Freedom from payment of taxes for promotion of any religion'?
qh: कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार 'किसी भी धर्म के प्रचार के लिए करों के भुगतान से स्वतंत्रता' प्रदान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: State should be secular. \\n2. Logic: Sarkar public tax ka paisa kisi ek dharam ko badhava dene ke liye kharch nahi kar sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye secularism ka 'Financial' aspect hai.

qe: Article 31A and 31B were added by which amendment to protect Land Reforms?
qh: भूमि सुधारों की रक्षा के लिए किस संशोधन द्वारा अनुच्छेद 31A और 31B जोड़े गए थे?
e: 1. Core Concept: Zamindari pratha ko khatam karna. \\n2. Logic: Rights ka bahana lekar amir log apni zameen bachane ke liye court ja rahe the, isliye ye protection laya gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isi ke sath '9th Schedule' bhi joda gaya tha.

qe: What is the 'Golden Triangle' of the Indian Constitution?
qh: भारतीय संविधान का 'स्वर्ण त्रिभुज' (Golden Triangle) क्या है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye teen Articles milkar azadi ki neev rakhte hain. \\n2. Logic: In teeno ka aapas mein gehra rishta hai. Ek ko khatam karne se dusre kamzor ho jate hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye concept 'Maneka Gandhi Case' mein bahut highlight hua tha.

qe: Article 28 prohibits religious instruction in:
qh: अनुच्छेद 28 किसमें धार्मिक शिक्षा पर रोक लगाता है?
o: Schools wholly maintained by State funds (पूरी तरह से राज्य निधि द्वारा संचालित स्कूल)
e: 1. Core Concept: Secular Education. \\n2. Logic: Jo school poori tarah sarkari paise se chalta hai, wahan dharam ki shiksha nahi di ja sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Private schools mein di ja sakti hai, par bache ko majboor nahi kiya ja sakta.

qe: Can Fundamental Rights be amended?
qh: क्या मौलिक अधिकारों में संशोधन किया जा सकता है?
o: Yes, by Constitutional Amendment without changing Basic Structure (मूल संरचना को बदले बिना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Flexibility with safety. \\n2. Logic: Kesavananda case ke baad Parliament amend toh kar sakti hai par Rights ki 'Atma' (Basic Structure) ko khatam nahi kar sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Right to Property ka hatna iska sabse bada example hai.

qe: Under Article 32, Supreme Court cannot refuse to hear a petition. Why?
qh: अनुच्छेद 32 के तहत, सुप्रीम कोर्ट याचिका सुनने से इनकार नहीं कर सकता। क्यों?
o: Because it is a discretionary power
Because Article 32 is itself a Fundamental Right (क्योंकि अनुच्छेद 32 स्वयं एक मौलिक अधिकार है)
Because it is a civil case
e: 1. Core Concept: Guaranteed Remedy. \\n2. Logic: Article 32 koi help nahi hai, wo nagrik ka 'Adhikar' hai. Court ki duty hai ise sunna. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isliye ise 'Constitutional Remedy' kehte hain.

qe: Article 15(3) allows 'Special Provisions' for:
qh: अनुच्छेद 15(3) किसके लिए 'विशेष प्रावधान' की अनुमति देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Protective Discrimination. \\n2. Logic: Mahilaon aur bacchon ko upar lane ke liye unhe special suvidha dena 'Equality' ke khilaaf nahi mana jata. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isi ke tehat 'Maternity Benefit' aur 'Free Schools' milte hain.

qe: The Supreme Court issues 'Writs' under which Article?
qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट किस अनुच्छेद के तहत 'रिट' (Writ) जारी करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Writs rights ko protect karne ka kanooni tool hain. \\n2. Logic: Agar koi adhikari aapka haq chine, toh SC Habeas Corpus, Mandamus jaisi 5 writs nikal sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: High Courts yahi power Article 226 ke andar use karte hain.

qe: Which Article provides protection against 'Double Jeopardy'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'दोहरे दंड' (Double Jeopardy) के खिलाफ सुरक्षा देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Iska matlab hai 'Ek jurm ki do baar saza nahi'. \\n2. Logic: Kisi insaan par ek hi crime ke liye do baar case nahi chalaya ja sakta. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'Self-Incrimination' (khud ke khilaaf gawah banne) se bhi bachata hai.

qe: Article 15 prohibits discrimination on how many specific grounds?
qh: अनुच्छेद 15 कितने विशिष्ट आधारों पर भेदभाव को रोकता है?
o: 5 (Religion, Race, Caste, Sex, Place of birth)
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye bhedbhav ko rokne ka sabse bada kanoon hai. \\n2. Logic: Dharam, moolvansh, jaati, ling aur janam-sthan ke adhar par koi bhedbhav nahi hoga. \\n3. Extra Fact: Is article ka upyog karke 'Reservation' (Arakshan) diya jata hai.

qe: Freedom of 'Press' is implied in which Article?
qh: 'प्रेस की स्वतंत्रता' किस अनुच्छेद में निहित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Press alag se likha nahi hai, par ye 'Freedom of Speech' ka hissa hai. \\n2. Logic: Bolne aur vichaar rakhne ki azadi mein hi media ki azadi chhupi hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Halanki is par 'Reasonable Restrictions' lagayi ja sakti hain (Desh ki suraksha ke liye).

qe: Articles 29 and 30 are related to:
qh: अनुच्छेद 29 और 30 किससे संबंधित हैं?
o: Cultural and Educational Rights (सांस्कृतिक और शैक्षणिक अधिकार)
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye 'Minorities' (Alpsankhyak) ke liye bane hain. \\n2. Logic: Iska maksad chote groups ki bhasha, script aur culture ko bachana hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 30 unhe apne 'Educational Institutions' kholne ki azadi deta hai.

qe: Which Fundamental Right can be suspended during National Emergency?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार निलंबित किया जा सकता है?
o: All except Article 20 and 21 (20 और 21 को छोड़कर)
e: 1. Core Concept: Emergency mein azadi kam ho jati hai. \\n2. Logic: Article 20 (Legal safety) aur Article 21 (Life) ko koi bhi emergency nahi cheen sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 19 (Speech) sabse pehle suspend hota hai.

qe: The 'Untouchability (Offences) Act' was renamed as:
qh: 'अस्पृश्यता (अपराध) अधिनियम' का नाम बदलकर क्या रखा गया?
o: Protection of Civil Rights Act (नागरिक अधिकार संरक्षण अधिनियम)
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye Article 17 ko lagu karne ke liye banaya gaya tha. \\n2. Logic: 1955 mein bane is kanoon ko 1976 mein naya naam diya gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme chhua-chhoot karne par jail aur fine dono ka pravdhan hai.

qe: Right to 'Privacy' is a Fundamental Right under:
qh: 'निजता का अधिकार' किस अनुच्छेद के तहत एक मौलिक अधिकार है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Privacy insaan ki dignity ka hissa hai. \\n2. Logic: 2017 ke Puttaswamy Case mein SC ne ise Article 21 ke andar Life ka part mana. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iska matlab hai ki sarkar bina wajah aapki personal life mein dakhal nahi de sakti.

qe: Who is the 'Guardian' of Fundamental Rights in India?
qh: भारत में मौलिक अधिकारों का 'अभिभावक' कौन है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Rights sirf likhne se nahi, bachane se bante hain. \\n2. Logic: Agar Parliament koi galat kanoon banaye, toh Courts use 'Unconstitutional' keh kar radd kar sakte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Supreme Court ko 'Final Interpreter' aur 'Guardian' kaha jata hai.

qe: Article 16 guarantees equality of opportunity in:
qh: अनुच्छेद 16 किस क्षेत्र में अवसर की समानता की गारंटी देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Har nagrik ko sarkari naukri pane ka barabar haq hai. \\n2. Logic: Caste ya Religion ke adhar par naukri dene mein bhedbhav nahi kiya jayega. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isi article ke exception ke roop mein 'Backward Classes' ko reservation milta hai.

qe: Article 25 provides freedom of 'Conscience' and:
qh: अनुच्छेद 25 'अंतरात्मा' और किसकी स्वतंत्रता प्रदान करता है?
o: Free profession/practice of religion (धर्म को मानने/प्रचार की स्वतंत्रता)
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye individual religious freedom hai. \\n2. Logic: Aap kisi bhi dharam ko maan sakte hain aur uski puja-path kar sakte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Sikhon ko 'Kirpan' dharan karne ki azadi isi Article se milti hai.

qe: Which Article allows the Parliament to restrict rights of 'Armed Forces'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद संसद को 'सशस्त्र बलों' के अधिकारों को प्रतिबंधित करने की अनुमति देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Discipline banaye rakhne ke liye kuch restrictions zaroori hain. \\n2. Logic: Army, Police aur Intelligence officers ko wo sabhi azadi (jaise strike karna) nahi milti jo aam nagriko ko milti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye power sirf 'Parliament' ke paas hai, State Assembly ke paas nahi.

qe: Article 23 prohibits which of the following?
qh: अनुच्छेद 23 निम्नलिखित में से किस पर रोक लगाता है?
o: Human Trafficking and Forced Labor (मानव तस्करी और जबरन श्रम)
e: 1. Core Concept: Insaano ki kharid-farokht aur 'Begar' (bina paise ke kaam) jurm hai. \\n2. Logic: Ye gareeb aur kamzor logon ko shoshan se bachata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Trafficking' ka matlab hai insaano ko saaman ki tarah bechna ya kharidna.

qe: The writ of 'Habeas Corpus' literally means:
qh: 'बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण' (Habeas Corpus) रिट का शाब्दिक अर्थ है:
o: To have the body (शरीर को प्रस्तुत करना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye illegal arrest ke khilaaf sabse bada hathiyar hai. \\n2. Logic: Court jailer ko order deta hai ki 'Kaidi ko hamare samne pesh karo' taaki arrest ki kanooniyat check ho sake. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Bulwark of Individual Liberty' bhi kaha jata hai.

qe: Which Article was described as 'Blanket Provision' for Minorities?
qh: अल्पसंख्यकों के लिए किसे 'ब्लैंकेट प्रोविज़न' कहा गया था?
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye minorities ke 'Culture' aur 'Language' ko protect karta hai. \\n2. Logic: Kisi bhi group ko apni bhasha aur lipi (script) bachane ka poora adhikaar hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme 'Religious' aur 'Linguistic' dono tarah ki minorities shamil hain.

qe: Article 13 declares any law 'Void' if it violates Fundamental Rights.
qh: अनुच्छेद 13 किसी भी कानून को 'शून्य' घोषित करता है यदि वह मौलिक अधिकारों का उल्लंघन करता है।
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye 'Judicial Review' ka base hai. \\n2. Logic: Samvidhan se upar koi kanoon nahi ho sakta. Agar koi naya kanoon Rights ke khilaaf hai, toh Article 13 use khatam kar deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye power Courts ko Samvidhan ka asli rakshak banati hai.

qe: The 'Right to Strike' is a Fundamental Right in India.
qh: 'हड़ताल का अधिकार' भारत में एक मौलिक अधिकार है।
e: 1. Core Concept: 'Association' banana right hai, par strike karna nahi. \\n2. Logic: Ye ek 'Legal Right' ho sakta hai par 'Fundamental Right' nahi hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Supreme Court ne kayi bar kaha hai ki sarkari karmachari strike ko mool adhikar nahi maan sakte.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Martial Law'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'मार्शल लॉ' (सैनिक शासन) का प्रावधान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Extraordinary halat mein Army ka control. \\n2. Logic: Agar kisi area mein dange ya yuddh ke karan civil administration fail ho jaye, toh wahan Martial Law lagaya ja sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: India mein abhi tak National level par Martial Law nahi laga hai.

qe: Right to 'Move freely throughout India' is under which Article?
qh: 'पूरे भारत में स्वतंत्र रूप से घूमने' का अधिकार किस अनुच्छेद के तहत है?
e: 1. Core Concept: India ek hai, isliye koi bhi nagrik kahin bhi ja sakta hai. \\n2. Logic: Ye Article 19(1)(d) ke andar aata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Is par 'Public Order' aur 'Scheduled Tribes' ke hito ke liye restrictions lagayi ja sakti hain.

qe: Article 22 provides protection against 'Arrest and Detention'. When should the person be produced before a Magistrate?
qh: अनुच्छेद 22 गिरफ्तारी के खिलाफ सुरक्षा देता है। व्यक्ति को मजिस्ट्रेट के सामने कब पेश किया जाना चाहिए?
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye police ki manmani rokne ke liye hai. \\n2. Logic: Arrest ke 24 ghante ke andar (travelling time chhod kar) Magistrate ki permission leni zaroori hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Punitive Detention' mein safety milti hai.

qe: The writ of 'Quo-Warranto' means:
qh: 'अधिकार पृच्छा' (Quo-Warranto) रिट का अर्थ है:
e: 1. Core Concept: Illegal occupation of public office ko rokna. \\n2. Logic: Court kisi bhi officer se puch sakta hai ki 'Aap kis haq se is kursi par baithe hain?'. \\n3. Extra Fact: Agar appointment galat payi jati hai, toh us insaan ko hata diya jata hai.

qe: Fundamental Rights are 'Justiciable'. What does it mean?
qh: मौलिक अधिकार 'न्यायोचित' हैं। इसका क्या अर्थ है?
o: They are enforceable in courts (अदालत द्वारा लागू किए जा सकते हैं)
They are only for the rich
e: 1. Core Concept: Bina kanooni taqat ke adhikar sirf kagaz par hain. \\n2. Logic: Agar koi Rights ka उल्लंघन kare, toh aap seedha Court ja kar use 'Enforce' karwa sakte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'DPSP' (Part IV) ke bilkul ulta hai jo non-justiciable hain.

qe: The 'Cultural and Educational Rights' are meant for which group?
qh: 'सांस्कृतिक और शैक्षणिक अधिकार' किस समूह के लिए हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Chote groups ki identity bachana. \\n2. Logic: Muslims, Sikhs, Christians ya Linguistic groups ko apni bhasha aur dharam ke institutions chalane ka haq hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 30 unhe 'Government aid' lene ka bhi barabar haq deta hai.

qe: Article 21A (Right to Education) was made effective from which year?
qh: अनुच्छेद 21A (शिक्षा का अधिकार) किस वर्ष से प्रभावी हुआ?
e: 1. Core Concept: Amendment 2002 mein hua par law 2010 mein aaya. \\n2. Logic: 1 April 2010 se RTE Act poore desh mein lagu kiya gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ab 6-14 saal ke har bacche ko sarkari school mein free education milna uska mool adhikar hai.

qe: Which Fundamental Right provides for 'Equality of Status and Opportunity'?
qh: कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार 'प्रतिष्ठा और अवसर की समानता' प्रदान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye Part III ka pehla mukhya right hai (Art 14-18). \\n2. Logic: Iska maksad samaj mein kisi bhi tarah ke 'Privilege' ya 'Bhedbhav' ko khatam karna hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Preamble ka vision isi right se poora hota hai.

qe: The writ of 'Mandamus' cannot be issued against:
qh: 'परमादेश' (Mandamus) रिट किसके खिलाफ जारी नहीं की जा सकती?
e: 1. Core Concept: Mandamus ka matlab hai 'Hum order dete hain'. \\n2. Logic: Ye President ya Governor ke khilaaf nahi nikali ja sakti (kuch kanooni immunities ke karan). \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye tab nikalte hain jab koi sarkari adhikari apna kaam karne se mana kar de.

qe: Which Article allows for 'Reasonable Restrictions' on Freedom of Speech?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद बोलने की स्वतंत्रता पर 'उचित प्रतिबंध' की अनुमति देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Azadi ka matlab 'Absolute' azadi nahi hai. \\n2. Logic: Aap aisa kuch nahi bol sakte jo desh ki 'Unity', 'Security' ya 'Public Order' ko khatra pahunchaye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Defamation (Maanhani) bhi isi restriction ke andar aati hai.

qe: Under Article 35, who has the power to make laws to give effect to Fundamental Rights?
qh: अनुच्छेद 35 के तहत मौलिक अधिकारों को प्रभावी बनाने के लिए कानून बनाने की शक्ति किसके पास है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Poore desh mein Rights ke kanoon ek jaise hone chahiye. \\n2. Logic: Agar State Assemblies kanoon banayengi toh har jagah rights alag honge, isliye ye power sirf Parliament ko di gayi hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Jaise Untouchability Act sirf Sansad ne banaya hai.

qe: The 'Suspension' of Fundamental Rights during Emergency is inspired from:
qh: आपातकाल के दौरान अधिकारों का 'निलंबन' किस देश से प्रेरित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Emergency provisions alag hain aur rights suspension alag. \\n2. Logic: Germany ke Weimar Constitution se humne ye concept liya hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Halanki Article 20 aur 21 kabhi suspend nahi hote, ye India ka apna add-on hai.

qe: Article 12 defines 'The State'. Does it include Municipalities?
qh: अनुच्छेद 12 'राज्य' को परिभाषित करता है। क्या इसमें नगर पालिकाएं शामिल हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Rights kiske khilaaf milte hain? 'State' ke khilaaf. \\n2. Logic: Parliament, Govt, Local bodies (Panchayat, Municipality) aur LIC, ONGC jaisi bodies sab 'State' hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Agar inme se koi bhi aapka haq chine, toh aap un par case kar sakte hain.

qe: Which Article forbids 'Begar' (Forced Labor)?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'बेगार' (जबरन श्रम) पर रोक लगाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Bina marzi aur bina paise ke kaam karwana jurm hai. \\n2. Logic: Purane zamane mein zamindar logon se zabardasti kaam karwate the, Article 23 use khatam karta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Rights nagriko aur videshiyo dono ke liye hain.

qe: The writ of 'Certiorari' is issued by a Higher Court to a Lower Court to:
qh: 'उत्प्रेषण' (Certiorari) रिट एक उच्च न्यायालय द्वारा निचले न्यायालय को क्यों जारी की जाती है?
o: Quash an order (आदेश को रद्द करने के लिए)
e: 1. Core Concept: Galat kanooni faislo ko sudharna. \\n2. Logic: Agar lower court ne apni jurisdiction se bahar ja kar faisla diya hai, toh High Court use cancel (Quash) kar deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'Preventive' aur 'Curative' dono tarah ki writ hai.

qe: Article 21 was expanded to include 'Right to Livelihood' in which case?
qh: किस मामले में अनुच्छेद 21 का विस्तार 'आजीविका के अधिकार' को शामिल करने के लिए किया गया?
e: 1. Core Concept: Jeene ke liye kamana zaroori hai. \\n2. Logic: Court ne kaha ki agar kisi se kamane ka rasta chin liya jaye, toh uska jeene ka adhikar (Right to Life) khatam ho jayega. \\n3. Extra Fact: Olga Tellis case 'Pavement dwellers' (patri par rehne wale) se juda tha.

qe: Article 27 says 'No person shall be compelled to pay any taxes for...'
qh: अनुच्छेद 27 कहता है 'किसी भी व्यक्ति को किसके लिए कर देने के लिए मजबूर नहीं किया जाएगा...'
o: Promotion of any religion (किसी धर्म के प्रचार के लिए)
e: 1. Core Concept: India ka secular character. \\n2. Logic: Sarkar public money ka use kisi ek dharam ko badhava dene ke liye nahi kar sakti. \\n3. Extra Fact: Halanki 'Fee' li ja sakti hai (jaise yatriyo se suvidha ke liye), par 'Tax' nahi.

qe: Which Fundamental Right provides for 'Freedom to manage religious affairs'?
qh: कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार 'धार्मिक मामलों के प्रबंधन की स्वतंत्रता' प्रदान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye group ya community ki religious freedom hai. \\n2. Logic: Har dharam ko apne trust banane, property rakhne aur rito (rituals) ko manage karne ka haq hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 25 individual ke liye hai, Article 26 group ke liye.

qe: The 'Right against Exploitation' covers which articles?
qh: 'शोषण के खिलाफ अधिकार' किन अनुच्छेदों को कवर करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Ye kamzor vargo ki suraksha ke liye hai. \\n2. Logic: Article 23 trafficking/forced labor rokta hai, aur Article 24 child labor. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye rights 'Positive rights' mane jate hain kyunki ye state se kuch karne ki ummid karte hain.

qe: Which Fundamental Right is also called the 'Soul' of the Rights section?
qh: अधिकारों के खंड की 'आत्मा' किसे कहा जाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Bina remedies ke rights bekar hain. \\n2. Logic: Article 32 rights ko real banata hai kyunki ye unhe Supreme Court dwara protect karwata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Fundamental of Fundamental Rights' bhi kehte hain.

qe: The 'Fundamental Rights' are not absolute but qualified. This means:
qh: मौलिक अधिकार पूर्ण नहीं बल्कि सीमित (Qualified) हैं। इसका अर्थ है:
o: Government can put reasonable restrictions (सरकार उचित प्रतिबंध लगा सकती है)
They apply only to some people
They are only for the poor
e: 1. Core Concept: Rights aur Duties ka balance. \\n2. Logic: Aapki azadi wahan khatam hoti hai jahan dusre ki naak shuru hoti hai. Desh ki suraksha ke liye in par rok lagayi ja sakti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Reasonable' hai ya nahi, ye hamesha Court decide karta hai.

qe: Which fundamental right cannot be suspended even during Emergency?
qh: आपातकाल के दौरान भी कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार निलंबित नहीं किया जा सकता?
o: Right to Life and Personal Liberty (अनुच्छेद 21)
e: Articles 20 and 21 remain active during National Emergency. / राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान अनुच्छेद 20 और 21 सक्रिय रहते हैं।

qe: Which article of the Indian Constitution is related to the 'Right to Privacy'?
qh: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'निजता के अधिकार' से संबंधित है?
e: The Supreme Court declared Right to Privacy as a Fundamental Right under Article 21. / सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने अनुच्छेद 21 के तहत निजता के अधिकार को मौलिक अधिकार घोषित किया।

qe: Which part of the Constitution is called 'Magna Carta of India'?
qh: संविधान के किस भाग को 'भारत का मैग्ना कार्टा' कहा जाता है?
e: Part III contains the Fundamental Rights. / भाग III में मौलिक अधिकार शामिल हैं।

qe: Which Fundamental Right was described by Dr. Ambedkar as the 'Heart and Soul' of the Constitution?
qh: किस मौलिक अधिकार को डॉ. अम्बेडकर ने संविधान का 'हृदय और आत्मा' कहा था?
e: Article 32 allows citizens to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of rights. / अनुच्छेद 32 नागरिकों को अधिकारों के प्रवर्तन के लिए सुप्रीम कोर्ट जाने की अनुमति देता है।

qe: Which Article deals with the 'Abolition of Untouchability'?
qh: 'अस्पृश्यता के उन्मूलन' से संबंधित कौन सा अनुच्छेद है?
e: Article 17 forbids the practice of untouchability in any form. / अनुच्छेद 17 किसी भी रूप में अस्पृश्यता के अभ्यास को रोकता है।
